His hair is pushed upward and forward with matte clay, showing a slight natural wave, visible natural growth patterns, no harsh part, and subtle flyaways catching against the sky on the left edge. He holds a deliberately posed, serious expression with a closed mouth, neutral eyebrows, and a direct gaze facing the camera. Wearing a crisp white t-shirt and jeans, he stands with level shoulders, his weight leaning slightly to the right. His left hand is tucked into his front left jeans pocket with the thumb hidden, revealing a silver watch on his wrist, while his relaxed right hand rests naturally on a brushed metal top rail with fingers spread and draped gently over the downward edge of a pristine glass balcony railing. This foreground glass and metal barrier sweeps from the bottom left toward the center, opening up to a deep outdoor spatial depth. The blurred midground features weathered urban buildings constructed from raw, cool blue-gray matte concrete with patchy, slightly textured facades, dense overlapping rooftops, and scattered glowing interior lights. In the deep background on the top left, the aged historic stone structure of the Galata Tower stands prominently, its conical top illuminated. The scene is bathed in mixed, diffused frontal soft fill flash of moderate intensity and neutral temperature, creating a calm, sophisticated twilight mood. Subtle highlights gently illuminate the subject's forehead and nose bridge, while soft, gradual gray shadows fall under his chin and behind his right arm. The complementary color palette balances the crisp white of his shirt with a dominant twilight blue atmosphere and delicate accents of sunset peach along a warm horizon gradient. Captured as a tack-sharp, grain-free digital photograph using an 85mm lens at f/2.8 for a medium depth of field that smoothly blurs the cityscape, this straight-on perspective is influenced by clean urban lifestyle photography and features post-processing with cool shadows and subtle skin smoothing, all perfectly framed in a 3:4 aspect ratio.

title: B&W
description:
Create a hyper-realistic 8K cinematic black-and-white portrait of the uploaded person in a dramatic chiaroscuro style. The subject is seated at a three-quarter angle, leaning slightly forward with a relaxed yet commanding posture. His face is turned slightly away from the camera,not looking at the lens, with one side of the face sharply illuminated and the opposite side fading into deep, velvety black shadow. 
His expression is contemplative.
His hands are near the chest in a natural, precise pose, with the fingers gently and correctly interlocked. One wrist clearly shows a luxury black chronograph watch with a detailed metal link bracelet, and one hand wears a subtle silver ring. He is dressed in a sharp black suit jacket over a white dress shirt with the top buttons open, showing refined fabric texture and natural folds.
The background is solid seamless black. Use strong directional studio lighting with rich contrast, clean shadow falloff, and realistic skin texture. Highlight fine details such as hair strands, beard(if present) bristles, eye moisture, facial texture, the watch face, metal bracelet reflections, and the silver ring. Shot with an 85mm portrait lens look, shallow depth of field, premium commercial photography, ultra-sharp focus, smooth natural skin transitions, cinematic contrast, no artificial plastic skin, no extra fingers, no distorted hands, no messy anatomy.
Aspect ratio 4:5.

• Analyze the uploaded photo first.
Identify the main object (shape,silhouette, texture, color) and enhance the original photo naturally (brightness,
exposure, contrast, white balance, sharpness, clarity, realistic high-resolution quality) while preserving the original composition, perspective, and colors.
Then transform the main object into a completely new illustrated conçept using hand-drawn doodles.
The rea object must remain visible and become an essential part of the illustration-not covered or replaced.
Build the idea from the object's geometry, not from common doodle tropes. Before drawing, imagine multiple possibilities and choose the most original, surprising, and visually satisfying one.
The doodles may include anything (people, animals, fantasy creatures, architecture, vehicles, landscapes, food, planets, etc.) only if they best fit the object's shape.
Never default
to repeated cute characters or reuse the same concept across different images.
The final result should seamlessly blend reality and illustration into a clever optical illusion, as if thephotographed object naturally
belongs to another magical world
Style: whimsical, kawaii, cozy, storybook, playful, minimalist hand-drawn doodles. Prioritize originality, storytelling, and interaction with the real object over decoration.
